label.zh: 这件奇物是我们从未研发过的，它不仅是活体金属的一种宝贵来源，还具有科研与历史价值。
label.en: This curious object is unlike anything we have developed. It is not only useful as a source of Living Metal, but also serves as a scientific and historical curiosity worth studying.

label.zh: 一个因无法自我调整而覆灭的种族无可歌颂。这些遗物就该被销毁，彻底消失在历史里。
label.en: There is nothing to be admired about a civilization that failed to adapt and went extinct. The artifact is to be disposed of and forgotten.
